body.p: Claims 2-21 are currently pending in the present application. Claims 2-21 have been rejected. Claims 4, 10, 13, 19, and 21 have been amended by this response. Support for the amendments to claims 4 and 13 can be found throughout the specification, for example, at [0087] of the specification. Support for the amendments to claims 10 and 19 can be found throughout the specification, for example, at [0088] of the specification. Claim 21 is amended for clarity. Applicant respectfully requests favorable reconsideration of this application, as amended. No new matter has been added.

Applicant has amended claims in this application. Applicant is not conceding in this application that the original or previous claims are not patentable over the references cited in the Office Action, as the present claim amendments are for facilitating expeditious prosecution of the claimed subject matter. Applicant respectfully reserves the right to pursue the original and other claims in one or more continuations and/or divisional patent applications.

Claims 2-21 are rejected on the ground of nonstatutory double patenting as being allegedly unpatentable over claims 1-20 of U.S. Patent No. 11,911,701. Applicant submits a terminal disclaimer with this response. As a result, applicant respectfully requests that the rejection be withdrawn.

Applicant respectfully submits that the present claims are in condition for allowance and an early Notice of Allowance is earnestly sought. The undersigned may be contacted at the telephone number below at the Examiner's convenience if it would help in the prosecution of this matter.

The Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge to the Deposit Account No. 50-5597 (RC-0075-02-US-CON) any (entity large size) deficiency of fees under 37 C.F.R. §§ 1.16 and 1.17 that may be required by this paper and to credit any overpayment to that Account. If any extension of time is required in connection with the filing of this paper and has not been separately requested, such extension is hereby requested.
